control_dashboard.title: Cockpit Control Panel
control_dashboard.aria_snapshot:
- banner:
  - heading "Cockpit Control Panel" [level=1]
  - text: "connected sim: connected video: up"
  - link "Open cockpit ↗":
    - /url: http://localhost:4010
- main:
  - heading "Simulator" [level=2]
  - button "Start"
  - button "Stop"
  - button "Reset"
  - text: Speed
  - spinbutton "Speed": "1"
  - button "Apply"
  - text: tick 5058 · running · 1x
  - heading "Add drone" [level=2]
  - textbox "Name (optional)"
  - textbox "Latitude (optional)"
  - textbox "Longitude (optional)"
  - button "Add drone + dock"
  - button "Start all video"
  - button "Stop all video"
  - heading "Drones" [level=2]
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Drone Status Battery Height H-speed Dist. home Video Actions":
        - columnheader "Drone"
        - columnheader "Status"
        - columnheader "Battery"
        - columnheader "Height"
        - columnheader "H-speed"
        - columnheader "Dist. home"
        - columnheader "Video"
        - columnheader "Actions"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Drone 1 drone-1 · dock-1 standby 100 % 0.0 m 0.0 m/s 0 m on Take off Land Stop video Remove":
        - cell "Drone 1 drone-1 · dock-1"
        - cell "standby"
        - cell "100 %"
        - cell "0.0 m"
        - cell "0.0 m/s"
        - cell "0 m"
        - cell "on"

          - button "Take off"
          - button "Land" [disabled]
          - button "Stop video"
          - button "Remove"

        - cell "standby"
